source: Offline seed index aligned to the vendored SCF 2026.3 catalog pin (beacon/scf/catalog/). Not a live HackIDLE summary. Not authoritative for the full catalog.
note: This file indexes the offline control JSON slices only (IAC-02, CRY-07). It does not copy full-catalog totals. It does not set scf_version. That field is the engine and live-host release, not this seed index. Family control_count values are the 2026.3 pin totals for CRY and IAC from beacon/scf/catalog/families.json.
